title: Chronic Disease Management
desc: Diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and heart disease management with personalised care plans and regular reviews.
detail: We support patients living with chronic conditions through structured care plans (GPMPs), regular reviews, and coordinated specialist referrals to help you live your best life.
fullDesc: Living with a chronic condition requires consistent, coordinated care. Our GPs specialise in creating comprehensive GP Management Plans (GPMPs) and Team Care Arrangements (TCAs) that bring together all the healthcare professionals you need. We work collaboratively with specialists, allied health providers, and you — the patient — to manage conditions like diabetes, hypertension, asthma, heart disease, arthritis, and more.
